sources.notes: Only source found covering DTCC and DSU by name. Data originates from the State of Delaware payroll (OMB), which can be requested under Delaware FOIA as CSV/Excel (a 2024 MuckRock request asked OMB for all state compensation data; page returned 403 so outcome not verified).

sources.institutions_covered: State of Delaware payroll (higher-ed coverage unverified)

sources.institution: Delaware Department of Human Resources workforce report
sources.institutions_covered: Executive Branch only; explicitly excludes Higher Education

sources.blocker: No employee payroll dataset (searched catalog for salary, payroll, compensation, employee; only educator salary aggregates and credit card transactions)

private_extra: University of Delaware is privately governed but state-assisted; under Delaware FOIA it is only covered for public-funds/board matters and it does not publish employee pay beyond its IRS 990. No private colleges publishing extra data found.
gaps: No official online person-level pay for Delaware State University, Delaware Tech or University of Delaware. State payroll (which includes DTCC and DSU) is not published as open data; obtainable via FOIA to OMB.
notes: Treated University of Delaware as public-ish (listed in systems) but expect no data. News Journal (delawareonline) salary lookups reportedly existed but could not be located.
